  VERBATIM)

  $<TARGET_OBJECTS:lynx__base__src_base>
  
  $<TARGET_OBJECTS:lynx__base__src_datauri_utils>

  )

  lynx__base__trace__android_prebuild_jni_header
  )

  ${ROOT_PATH}/lynx/tools/android_tools/ndk/sources/cxx-stl/llvm-libc++/libs/arm64-v8a/
  )

  android
  c
  dl
  log
  m
  )

set(CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS} -Wl,--fatal-warnings -fPIC -Wl,-z,noexecstack -Wl,-z,now -Wl,-z,relro -Wl,-z,defs -Wl,--undefined-version --gcc-toolchain=/home/zsy/zsy/lynx/tools/android_tools/ndk/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64 -Wl,--no-undefined -Wl,--exclude-libs,ALL -fuse-ld=lld -Wl,--icf=all --target=aarch64-linux-android22 -Wl,--warn-shared-textrel --sysroot=/home/zsy/zsy/lynx/tools/android_tools/ndk/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/sysroot  -Wl,--warn-shared-textrel -Wl,-O2 -Wl,--gc-sections -Wl,--as-needed -flto -O2 -Wl,--exclude-libs,ALL,--gc-sections -fuse-ld=lld -Xlinker -Map=output.map -Wl,--version-script,/home/zsy/zsy/lynx/base/trace/android/lynx_trace_export_symbol.map ")
